limitations: Two predeclared development tasks with one K8 trial per condition; no replicated adaptation/generalization conclusion.
PPO normal/memory-reset/reward-blind share the same source checkpoint; trained-reset is a separately trained controller. All have7/8 bottle and0/8 stapler here.
SAC online target clone SGD is additional target adaptation cost, not a source update or progress toward source100-round quota.
The initial seeds/features/raw observations are paired; resulting trajectories differ by policy and recurrent/online learning history.
PPO source50 updates/250 optimizer steps and SAC source314500 updates/943500 total optimizer steps are different algorithmic counters, not directly comparable iterations.
Saved stage completion/RNG restoration and unchanged source counters were checked from JSON; this narrow audit did not reconstruct every historical gradient or reopen ledgers.
